description: 认证边界：伪造/过期/未知 token、设备撤销、RLS 权限矩阵

steps.sql: SELECT has_table_privilege('anon','tokentracker_hourly','SELECT') AS anon_read, has_table_privilege('authenticated','tokentracker_hourly','SELECT') AS user_read, has_function_privilege('authenticated','cloud_ingest_usage(text,text,jsonb,jsonb,text)','EXECUTE') AS direct_upload, has_function_privilege('authenticated','account_summary_wire(uuid,uuid,timestamptz,timestamptz,text,integer,text,text)','EXECUTE') AS direct_private_read

SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.tokentracker_cloud_machines) AS machines, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.tokentracker_cloud_machine_aliases) AS aliases, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.tokentracker_devices) AS devices, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM public.tokentracker_hourly) AS hourly
